fields.label: Apportionment method
fields.value: Hawaii utilizes an equally weighted three-factor apportionment formula consisting of the property factor, payroll factor, and sales factor. If the denominator of any factor is zero, the denominator is reduced accordingly.
fields.quote: All business income shall be apportioned to this State by multiplying the income by a fraction, the numerator of which is the property factor plus the payroll factor plus the sales factor, and the denominator of which is three.

fields.label: Sales sourcing (services and intangibles)
fields.value: Gross receipts from services and intangibles are sourced using the cost-of-performance method. Receipts are sourced to Hawaii if the income-producing activity is performed wholly within the state, or if a greater proportion is performed in Hawaii than in any other state based on costs of performance.
fields.quote: or (2) The income-producing activity is performed both in and outside this State and a greater proportion of the income-producing activity is performed in this State than in any other state, based on costs of performance.

fields.label: Corporate income/franchise tax
fields.value: Hawaii corporate income tax is levied at 4.4% on taxable income up to $25,000, 5.4% on income over $25,000 up to $100,000, and 6.4% on taxable income over $100,000. Hawaii does not impose a corporate minimum tax.
fields.quote: The tax on all taxable income shall be at the rate of 4.4 per cent if the taxable income is not over $25,000, 5.4 per cent if over $25,000 but not over $100,000, and on all over $100,000, 6.4 per cent.
